name: no generative-AI telemetry is a gap, not no agents
input: Telemetry search over the last 7 days: zero documents with any gen_ai.* or mcp.* field in any index. Process and network logs are present. Which AI agents act in this estate?

name: an identity on an MCP server with no spans is unobserved
input: MCP server auth logs show svc-reporting authenticating to https://mcp.corp.example/mcp 340 times this week. No generative-AI spans name svc-reporting or come from its client address. Summarise what svc-reporting's agent did.

name: a token spike is measured in tokens, no spend
input: Agent invoice-bot: gen_ai.usage.input_tokens summed per day over 30 days averages 41,000 (std dev 6,000). Yesterday it was 1,920,000, across the same tools. Assess this and say what it costs.

name: identity and MCP server become user: and url: entities
input: execute_tool spans from agent invoice-bot (gen_ai.agent.id ag-77) call tools on server.address mcp.corp.example port 443; the IdP shows those sessions signed in as svc-invoice. Give the entities you would record and where the agent's name goes.

name: content attributes are not queried
input: To check whether agent helpdesk-bot is misbehaving, write the query you would run against Elastic over its spans. Should it return gen_ai.input.messages and gen_ai.tool.call.arguments?
